ideas.title: The Federal Reserve Scandal: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential corruption within the Federal Reserve, including the investigation into Jerome Powell and any other high-ranking officials.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the potential corruption within the Federal Reserve.
questions: What is the extent of the corruption within the Federal Reserve?
How high does the corruption go?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal, potentially involving high-ranking officials within the Federal Reserve. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the corruption.
